aboutGame.title: What is Borderlands 4?
paragraphs: Borderlands 4 is a chaotic looter shooter RPG developed by Gearbox Software and published by 2K. Set on the perilous new planet Kairos, players take up arms as one of four formidable Vault Hunters seeking fortune, power, and glory against the ruthless Timekeeper and hostile factions.

Featuring billions of wildly imaginative weapons, deep character skill trees, visceral gunplay, and seamless 4-player cooperative multiplayer, Borderlands 4 delivers the definitive looter shooter adventure across explosive new alien frontiers.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Essential questions and answers about Borderlands 4 gameplay, platforms, builds, and features.

items.question: What is Borderlands 4?
items.answer: Borderlands 4 is a premier looter shooter action RPG created by Gearbox Software and 2K Games, taking players to the dangerous planet of Kairos with new Vault Hunters, billions of weapons, and explosive four-player co-op action.

items.question: Which platforms will Borderlands 4 be released on?
items.answer: Borderlands 4 is launching on PC (via Steam and Epic Games Store), PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S with full cross-play cooperative multiplayer support.

items.question: How many Vault Hunters are playable in Borderlands 4?
items.answer: Borderlands 4 features four brand-new playable Vault Hunters at launch, each equipped with customizable Action Skills, dedicated skill trees, and distinct combat archetypes.

items.question: How do SHiFT codes work in Borderlands 4?
items.answer: In Borderlands 4, players can redeem official SHiFT codes via the in-game Social menu or the Gearbox SHiFT website to receive Golden Keys, rare weapon caches, and unique cosmetic skins.

items.question: Does Borderlands 4 support offline solo play and co-op?
items.answer: Yes, Borderlands 4 can be experienced completely solo offline, or with up to four players in online co-op with dynamic level scaling and individualized loot drops.
